candelabra.look: a branched CANDELABRA: an ornate metal stand holding three or five tall candles, each with a small warm flame. Elegant.

candle.look: a single lit CANDLE in a small holder: a short pale candle with a small warm glowing FLAME on top, on a little dish. Tiny.

lamp_floor.look: a standing FLOOR LAMP: a slim vertical pole on a small round base, topped with a wide trapezoid LAMPSHADE (wider at the bottom) that GLOWS warm yellow. The shade is a lampshade, NOT a tent, teepee or pyramid.

lamp_floor_fancy.look: an elegant BRASS FLOOR LAMP: a slim ornate brass pole on a round base topped with a fringed fabric LAMPSHADE that glows warm. Fancier than a plain floor lamp.

lamp_post.look: an outdoor LAMP POST: a tall slim dark metal POLE on a small round base, topped with a glass LANTERN that glows warm yellow. A garden/street lamp, taller than wide.

lantern.look: a metal LANTERN: a small framed glass lantern with a warm glowing flame inside and a ring handle on top. Compact.
